title: Biblical Commentary on the Book of Daniel (Keil & Delitzsch, Biblical Commentary on the Old Testament)

verification_log.method: Downloaded and read the OCR text (chs. 9 and 12)

pp. 373–374, 399–402: the seventy "sevens" are symbolic, not chronological (after Kliefoth and Leyrer); seven sevens from the word to restore Jerusalem (Isa 44:28, Cyrus) to the Messiah, sixty-two of building in troubled times, the last week the final enemy; pp. 500–502: the 1,290 and 1,335 days are symbolic; no event 45 days after Antiochus's death marks a better time (1 Macc 6:18–54; 7:26–50)
